questions.stem: A 35 y G2A1 at 8 weeks presents with light vaginal bleeding and mild abdominal cramps. The patient had infertility and conceived by ovulation induction. Her earlier pregnancy was an ectopic pregnancy which was treated medically. On examination, her BP is 116/64 mmHg, and PR is 76/ min. Speculum exam shows minimal bleeding and a closed cervix. Bimanual exam reveals a 10-week uterus with no adnexal mass or tenderness. Two 8 – week intra uterine gestations with normal heartbeats are seen on a TVS. What is the diagnosis?
